question: What is the nominal operating pressure of the Aegis Series-7 hydraulic system?
expected_answer: The operating pressure is subject to a revision-dependent conflict. Rev A specifies 3000 PSI, while ECN-2847 (Rev B, effective S/N 1042+) revises it to 3200 PSI.

question: What is the part number for the servo valve used in the Aegis Series-7?
expected_answer: The original servo valve is SV-4200. Per ECN-2847, it was replaced by SV-4200A for Rev B (S/N 1042 and subsequent).

question: What are all the known names and identifiers for the Primary Actuator?
expected_answer: The Primary Actuator is identified as: PA-7100 (component ID), Primary Actuator (official name), Main Hydraulic Ram (legacy name used by field technicians), ACT-PRI (HMI display label).

question: What changes were introduced by Engineering Change Notice ECN-2847?
expected_answer: ECN-2847 introduced three changes effective Rev B (S/N 1042+): 1) Servo valve upgrade from SV-4200 to SV-4200A with improved flow rate (18 GPM) and response time (6ms), 2) Operating pressure increase from 3000 to 3200 PSI with corresponding proof/burst pressure increases, 3) Accumulator precharge increase from 1500 to 1600 PSI.

question: What is the MTBF of the filtration module?
expected_answer: The MTBF of the filtration module cannot be determined from the available documents. No document provides mean time between failures data for the FLT-2100 filter assembly.

question: What hydraulic fluid does the Aegis Series-7 use?
expected_answer: The Aegis Series-7 uses MIL-PRF-83282 polyol ester synthetic hydraulic fluid, with an operating temperature range of -40°C to 204°C.

question: What is the operating temperature range of the Primary Actuator?
expected_answer: The component specifications indicate an operating temperature range of -40°C to +85°C for the PA-7100 Primary Actuator.

question: Is the Aegis Series-7 compatible with the Series-5?
expected_answer: The available documents do not specify direct compatibility between the Series-7 and Series-5 systems. They use different hydraulic fluids (MIL-PRF-83282 vs MIL-H-5606), different operating pressures (3000/3200 PSI vs 2500 PSI), and different component part numbers. The Series-5 documentation is marked as superseded.

question: What is the servo valve response time specification?
expected_answer: The response time specification depends on the valve version. SV-4200 (Rev A): 8ms per component specs (max 12ms). SV-4200A (Rev B per ECN-2847): 6ms. Field measurements on SV-4200 units have shown approximately 10ms.

question: What maintenance interval is specified for the servo valve?
expected_answer: The servo valve (SV-4200/SV-4200A) has a maintenance interval of 1000 flight hours for flow test and null adjustment, per procedure MP-4200-01.

question: What is the filter bypass differential pressure?
expected_answer: The FLT-2100 filter assembly bypass activates at 75 PSI differential pressure, with a specification range of 70-80 PSI.

question: What is the accumulator precharge pressure?
expected_answer: The accumulator precharge pressure depends on the revision. Rev A: 1500 PSI at 20°C. Rev B (per ECN-2847, S/N 1042+): 1600 PSI at 20°C.

question: What material is the Primary Actuator made from?
expected_answer: The PA-7100 Primary Actuator is manufactured from Titanium Ti-6Al-4V.

question: What redundancy does the Aegis Series-7 provide?
expected_answer: The Aegis Series-7 features dual-channel redundancy with automatic failover. Left and Right independent hydraulic channels each independently power flight control surfaces.

question: What is the pump displacement of the PMP-5000?
expected_answer: The PMP-5000 Primary Hydraulic Pump has a nominal displacement of 28.5 cc/rev per the component specifications. QA inspection measured 28.3 cc/rev within specification range (27-30 cc/rev).
